page.layout: One title page: the printed title in lines at the top, a woodcut ornament (engraving) in the centre, and a library stamp with a handwritten shelf mark at the foot. No running text.
page.notes: The title is very faint and partly blurred by show-through from the reverse, so the middle lines are not legible. The woodcut ornament in the centre is described only, not transcribed. The library stamp ("Staatsbibliothek"), the handwritten shelf mark "07/98/208" and the blue impression below the stamp are left out: the stamp and shelf mark are not printed text, and the blue lines below the stamp look like show-through. The first printed lines are read with [?] where doubtful.
